payload.text: hv, 17 Oct 10:5xZ, directly to vc, on issue 0066 after two rulings had been recorded in hv name (dc: the union, from hv answer to dc question; cc: the narrow numbering list, written as a Decision into the issue): THE UNION stands for both mermaid: and numbering:. on, true, yes and 1 turn a switch on; off, false, no and 0 turn it off; anything else is refused by name. dc owns the fix under the pen; cc is stopped off the files; vc reviews the landing and pushes; dc closes the issue on the evidence.
